body:
So, here’s how it started.  Alex was over at my house because his stepdad had triple bypass sugery.  I invited edwin and phillip, and we got started.  I don’t really remember the games all that well, actually it was only 1 game.  GAME 1:my WYS vs. Phillip’s No money no parts no deal.

ummmm.... he won, by alot.

GAME 2: yes, the second game which we weren’t able to finish.  I was playing edwin, but that’s beside the point

THE IMPORTANT GAME 2:Phillip’s Mind What You Have Learned Vs. Alex’s ......deck

If they had finished the game alex would’ve lost by only about 10 but only because he kept messing up phillip’s tracking

So here are the final standings:

4th place-Alex Olivo-differential=0(-41)

3rd place-Martin Warlick(woo hoo!)-differential=0(-36)

2nd place-Phillip Marshall-differential=2(36)

1st place-Edwin Harris-differential=2(41)













WELL, THAT WAS MARTIN-CON, YOU MIGHT BE ABLE TO COME TO IT-



                         NEXT YEAR

summary: Martin Warlick hosted 'Martin-Con', a four-player game session at his house in 2001, and finished 3rd (0 (−36)), losing to Philip Marschall's No Money, No Parts, No Deal deck with WYS; [[Edwin Harris]] won ahead of Marschall, Warlick and Alex Olivo.
notes: A private session of four friends at the author's house, filled as a casual event per Bill 2026-10-25; named after the session's own name ('THAT WAS MARTIN-CON'), '2001 Martin-Con', event_status new.

Date not stated: event_date 2001-08 from the posting date (20 August 2001); the session may have been earlier. Place not stated (the author's house); not inferred, though the players are from the Raleigh–Durham, North Carolina scene.
Format Premiere - Coruscant: Phillip's 'No money no parts no deal' is the Coruscant objective No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave? (Coruscant, August 2001).

'Phillip Marshall' mapped to [[Philip Marschall]] (page notes 'also published as Phillip Marshal'; plays in Raleigh with Warlick and Edwin Harris, e.g. [[June 2001 Raleigh tournament (9 June)]]), small-world rule. Edwin Harris = [[Edwin Harris]] (Durham/Raleigh player). Alex Olivo: no page.

Standings as listed: 1st Edwin Harris 2(41), 2nd Phillip Marshall 2(36), 3rd Martin Warlick 0(-36), 4th Alex Olivo 0(-41). Game 2 against Edwin was not finished (result null); author_record 0–1 counts only the decided game. Game 1 margin 'by alot' not recorded.
Phillip's 'Mind What You Have Learned' vs Alex was not finished ('alex would've lost by only about 10': hedged, not recorded); not the author's game.
WYS linked to Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough.
